Based on the scope of what was built, here's how I'd think about a monthly retainer:

## What a Retainer Would Cover

- **Content updates**: new treks, seasonal pricing, itinerary changes
- **Bilingual maintenance**: updates always need both EN + ZH
- **Dependency updates**: Next.js, Leaflet, Tailwind security patches
- **Bug fixes**: browser compat, mobile issues
- **Minor enhancements**: small UI tweaks, SEO adjustments
- **Map/GPS data**: new route files, altitude profiles
- **Hosting/deployment support**: build pipeline, static export

## Suggested Monthly Retainer

| Tier | Scope | Range |
|------|-------|-------|
| **Light** | ~2–4 hrs/mo. Content tweaks, bug fixes, dependency updates | **$150–300/mo** |
| **Standard** | ~5–10 hrs/mo. Above + new trek pages, seasonal updates, minor features | **$400–800/mo** |
| **Active** | ~10–20 hrs/mo. Above + new features, SEO work, analytics, ongoing development | **$1,000–1,500/mo** |

## My Recommendation

For a trekking company, content is **seasonal** — heavy updates before peak seasons (spring/autumn), quiet otherwise. Two approaches:

1. **Flat retainer at the Light tier ($200–300/mo)** with hourly overage for busy months. Predictable for the client, fair for you.

2. **Per-update billing** ($50–100 per trek update, $150–300 for a new trek page with maps) if the client prefers pay-as-you-go. Less predictable but no commitment friction.

For the **Nepal market**, scale down ~40%: a light retainer of **$100–150/mo** is more realistic. For a **Taiwan-based client**, the $200–300 range is standard.

The bilingual requirement is key — every content change is effectively double the work, which justifies the retainer over ad-hoc pricing.

Based on the scope analysis, here's how I'd frame it:

## Base Site (What's Built Now)

**$3,000–4,000 USD** — this is the deliverable as-is.

Frame it as: "You're getting a fully custom bilingual site with interactive maps, not a template."

## Add-On Menu

Present these as line items the client can pick from:

| Feature | One-Time Cost | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-------|
| **Additional language** (e.g. Japanese, Korean) | $500–800/lang | New dictionary file, QA across all pages |
| **New trek page** (full itinerary + map) | $200–400 | Day-by-day, GPS route, altitude chart |
| **SEO package** (meta, schema, sitemap, Google Search Console setup) | $300–500 | Some groundwork already done |
| **Google Analytics / tracking setup** | $150–250 | GA4 + basic event tracking |
| **Blog/news section** | $400–700 | Static or CMS-backed |
| **Booking/inquiry form** (WhatsApp, email, or third-party) | $200–400 | Would require moving off static export if server-side |
| **Testimonials/reviews section** | $150–300 | |
| **Content update** (text, images, pricing) | $50–100/page | Bilingual = 2x |
| **Remove/restructure pages** | $50–150 | Depends on scope |

## How to Pitch It

> "The base site is $X. Here's a menu of things we can add now or later. Pick what matters most for launch, and we can phase in the rest."

This gives the client control, avoids sticker shock, and creates a natural path to ongoing work. Start with the base + SEO + analytics as a recommended launch bundle (**~$3,500–4,500**), then upsell treks and languages as the business grows.

# Find Nepal Trek Website

Bilingual (English / Traditional Chinese) static website for **Find Nepal Trek Pvt. Ltd.** — a Nepal-based trekking company run by a Nepali guide and his Taiwanese wife.

Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Statically exported for deployment anywhere.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev -- -p 3002     # development on port 3002
```

Open [http://localhost:3002](http://localhost:3002) in your browser.

## Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm run dev` | Start dev server (default port 3000) |
| `npm run dev -- -p 3002` | Start dev server on port 3002 |
| `npm run build` | Build static site to `out/` directory |
| `npx serve out -l 3002` | Serve the static build on port 3002 |
| `npm run lint` | Run ESLint |

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 16** — App Router, static export (`output: "export"`)
- **TypeScript** — strict mode
- **Tailwind CSS v4** — utility-first styling with custom Nepal-inspired theme
- **React 19** — server and client components

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── globals.css              # Tailwind + custom theme (colors, animations)
│   ├── layout.tsx               # Root layout (fonts: Inter + Noto Sans TC)
│   ├── page.tsx                 # "/" — detects browser language, redirects to /en or /zh
│   └── [lang]/
│       ├── layout.tsx           # Shared header + footer, generateStaticParams
│       ├── page.tsx             # Home page
│       ├── dictionaries.ts      # Dictionary loader
│       ├── about/page.tsx       # About Us — story + 6 core principles + stats
│       ├── treks/
│       │   ├── page.tsx         # Trek listing — all 6 treks as cards
│       │   └── [slug]/page.tsx  # Trek detail — itinerary, highlights, pricing sidebar
│       ├── team/page.tsx        # Team member profiles
│       ├── gallery/page.tsx     # Photo gallery with lightbox
│       └── contact/page.tsx     # Contact form + map + info
│
├── components/
│   ├── layout/                  # Header, Footer, Navigation, LanguageSwitcher
│   ├── home/                    # HeroBanner, ActivityCategories, FeaturedTreks, Testimonials, CTA
│   ├── treks/                   # ItineraryAccordion (client component)
│   ├── gallery/                 # GalleryGrid with lightbox (client component)
│   └── contact/                 # ContactForm (client component, mailto-based)
│
├── data/
│   ├── treks.ts                 # 6 treks with full bilingual content + itineraries
│   └── team.ts                  # 4 team members with bilingual bios
│
├── dictionaries/
│   ├── en.json                  # English UI translations
│   └── zh.json                  # Traditional Chinese UI translations
│
├── lib/
│   ├── i18n.ts                  # Locale config and types
│   └── utils.ts                 # localized() helper for bilingual data
│
└── types/
    └── trek.ts                  # Trek, TeamMember, TrekItineraryDay interfaces
```

## i18n Architecture

Language detection and routing works as follows:

1. **Root `/`** — Client component detects `navigator.language`; redirects to `/en` or `/zh`
2. **`/[lang]/*`** — Dynamic route segment with `generateStaticParams()` producing both `/en` and `/zh` variants
3. **Dictionaries** — JSON files (`en.json`, `zh.json`) loaded at build time via dynamic `import()`
4. **Trek data** — Bilingual fields inline (`nameEn`/`nameZh`, etc.) accessed via `localized()` helper
5. **Language switcher** — Header button swaps `/en/...` ↔ `/zh/...` in the current URL

## Pages

| Page | English | Chinese | Description |
|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| Home | `/en` | `/zh` | Hero, activities, featured treks, testimonials, CTA |
| About | `/en/about` | `/zh/about` | Company story, 6 principles, stats |
| Treks | `/en/treks` | `/zh/treks` | Listing of all 6 treks |
| Trek Detail | `/en/treks/[slug]` | `/zh/treks/[slug]` | Full itinerary, highlights, pricing sidebar |
| Team | `/en/team` | `/zh/team` | 4 team member profiles |
| Gallery | `/en/gallery` | `/zh/gallery` | Photo grid with lightbox |
| Contact | `/en/contact` | `/zh/contact` | Form, map, contact info |

## Treks

| Trek | Slug | Difficulty | Days | Max Altitude | Price |
|------|------|-----------|------|-------------|-------|
| Everest Base Camp | `everest-base-camp` | Challenging | 14 | 5,364m | $1,800 |
| Annapurna Circuit | `annapurna-circuit` | Challenging | 18 | 5,416m | $1,600 |
| Langtang Valley | `langtang-valley` | Moderate | 10 | 3,870m | $900 |
| Manaslu Circuit | `manaslu-circuit` | Strenuous | 16 | 5,106m | $2,200 |
| Poon Hill | `poon-hill` | Easy | 5 | 3,210m | $500 |
| Upper Mustang | `upper-mustang` | Moderate | 14 | 3,840m | $2,500 |

Each trek includes day-by-day itinerary with altitude/walking hours, highlights, and what's included.

## Theme

Nepal-inspired color palette defined in `globals.css`:

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `primary` | `#1B4332` | Deep forest green — headers, nav, buttons |
| `primary-light` | `#2D6A4F` | Hover states |
| `primary-dark` | `#081C15` | Dark backgrounds, hero overlays |
| `secondary` | `#D4A373` | Warm earth tone — accents, quotes |
| `accent` | `#E76F51` | Adventure orange — CTAs, prices |
| `accent-light` | `#F4A261` | Hover state for accent |

## Images

Downloaded assets are in `public/images/`. Trek hero images and gallery photos currently use gradient placeholders — replace with actual photos by adding images to:

- `public/images/treks/[slug]/hero.jpg` — Trek hero banner
- `public/images/treks/[slug]/1.jpg`, `2.jpg`, `3.jpg` — Trek gallery
- `public/images/gallery/1.jpg` through `12.jpg` — Main gallery
- `public/images/team/[id].jpg` — Team member photos

## Deployment

The site builds to static HTML in `out/`. Deploy to any static host:

```bash
npm run build
# Upload the out/ directory to your host
```

Compatible with: Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, any static file server.

## Contact

- **Phone:** +977 984 929 2486
- **Email:** info@findnepaltrek.com
- **Instagram:** [@find_nepal_trek](https://www.instagram.com/find_nepal_trek)

# Find Nepal Trek Website

Bilingual (English / Traditional Chinese) static website for **Find Nepal Trek Pvt. Ltd.** — a Nepal-based trekking company run by a Nepali guide and his Taiwanese wife.

Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Statically exported for deployment anywhere.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev -- -p 3002     # development on port 3002
```

Open [http://localhost:3002](http://localhost:3002) in your browser.

## Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm run dev` | Start dev server (default port 3000) |
| `npm run dev -- -p 3002` | Start dev server on port 3002 |
| `npm run build` | Build static site to `out/` directory |
| `npx serve out -l 3002` | Serve the static build on port 3002 |
| `npm run lint` | Run ESLint |

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 16** — App Router, static export (`output: "export"`)
- **TypeScript** — strict mode
- **Tailwind CSS v4** — utility-first styling with custom Nepal-inspired theme
- **React 19** — server and client components

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── globals.css              # Tailwind + custom theme (colors, animations)
│   ├── layout.tsx               # Root layout (fonts: Inter + Noto Sans TC)
│   ├── page.tsx                 # "/" — detects browser language, redirects to /en or /zh
│   └── [lang]/
│       ├── layout.tsx           # Shared header + footer, generateStaticParams
│       ├── page.tsx             # Home page
│       ├── dictionaries.ts      # Dictionary loader
│       ├── about/page.tsx       # About Us — story + 6 core principles + stats
│       ├── treks/
│       │   ├── page.tsx         # Trek listing — all 6 treks as cards
│       │   └── [slug]/page.tsx  # Trek detail — itinerary, highlights, pricing sidebar
│       ├── team/page.tsx        # Team member profiles
│       ├── gallery/page.tsx     # Photo gallery with lightbox
│       └── contact/page.tsx     # Contact form + map + info
│
├── components/
│   ├── layout/                  # Header, Footer, Navigation, LanguageSwitcher
│   ├── home/                    # HeroBanner, ActivityCategories, FeaturedTreks, Testimonials, CTA
│   ├── treks/                   # ItineraryAccordion (client component)
│   ├── gallery/                 # GalleryGrid with lightbox (client component)
│   └── contact/                 # ContactForm (client component, mailto-based)
│
├── data/
│   ├── treks.ts                 # 6 treks with full bilingual content + itineraries
│   └── team.ts                  # 4 team members with bilingual bios
│
├── dictionaries/
│   ├── en.json                  # English UI translations
│   └── zh.json                  # Traditional Chinese UI translations
│
├── lib/
│   ├── i18n.ts                  # Locale config and types
│   └── utils.ts                 # localized() helper for bilingual data
│
└── types/
    └── trek.ts                  # Trek, TeamMember, TrekItineraryDay interfaces
```

## i18n Architecture

Language detection and routing works as follows:

1. **Root `/`** — Client component detects `navigator.language`; redirects to `/en` or `/zh`
2. **`/[lang]/*`** — Dynamic route segment with `generateStaticParams()` producing both `/en` and `/zh` variants
3. **Dictionaries** — JSON files (`en.json`, `zh.json`) loaded at build time via dynamic `import()`
4. **Trek data** — Bilingual fields inline (`nameEn`/`nameZh`, etc.) accessed via `localized()` helper
5. **Language switcher** — Header button swaps `/en/...` ↔ `/zh/...` in the current URL

## Pages

| Page | English | Chinese | Description |
|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| Home | `/en` | `/zh` | Hero, activities, featured treks, testimonials, CTA |
| About | `/en/about` | `/zh/about` | Company story, 6 principles, stats |
| Treks | `/en/treks` | `/zh/treks` | Listing of all 6 treks |
| Trek Detail | `/en/treks/[slug]` | `/zh/treks/[slug]` | Full itinerary, highlights, pricing sidebar |
| Team | `/en/team` | `/zh/team` | 4 team member profiles |
| Gallery | `/en/gallery` | `/zh/gallery` | Photo grid with lightbox |
| Contact | `/en/contact` | `/zh/contact` | Form, map, contact info |

## Treks

| Trek | Slug | Difficulty | Days | Max Altitude | Price |
|------|------|-----------|------|-------------|-------|
| Everest Base Camp | `everest-base-camp` | Challenging | 14 | 5,364m | $1,800 |
| Annapurna Circuit | `annapurna-circuit` | Challenging | 18 | 5,416m | $1,600 |
| Langtang Valley | `langtang-valley` | Moderate | 10 | 3,870m | $900 |
| Manaslu Circuit | `manaslu-circuit` | Strenuous | 16 | 5,106m | $2,200 |
| Poon Hill | `poon-hill` | Easy | 5 | 3,210m | $500 |
| Upper Mustang | `upper-mustang` | Moderate | 14 | 3,840m | $2,500 |

Each trek includes day-by-day itinerary with altitude/walking hours, highlights, and what's included.

## Theme

Nepal-inspired color palette defined in `globals.css`:

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `primary` | `#1B4332` | Deep forest green — headers, nav, buttons |
| `primary-light` | `#2D6A4F` | Hover states |
| `primary-dark` | `#081C15` | Dark backgrounds, hero overlays |
| `secondary` | `#D4A373` | Warm earth tone — accents, quotes |
| `accent` | `#E76F51` | Adventure orange — CTAs, prices |
| `accent-light` | `#F4A261` | Hover state for accent |

## Images

Downloaded assets are in `public/images/`. Trek hero images and gallery photos currently use gradient placeholders — replace with actual photos by adding images to:

- `public/images/treks/[slug]/hero.jpg` — Trek hero banner
- `public/images/treks/[slug]/1.jpg`, `2.jpg`, `3.jpg` — Trek gallery
- `public/images/gallery/1.jpg` through `12.jpg` — Main gallery
- `public/images/team/[id].jpg` — Team member photos

## Deployment

The site builds to static HTML in `out/`. Deploy to any static host:

```bash
npm run build
# Upload the out/ directory to your host
```

Compatible with: Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, any static file server.

## Contact

- **Phone:** +977 984 929 2486
- **Email:** info@findnepaltrek.com
- **Instagram:** [@find_nepal_trek](https://www.instagram.com/find_nepal_trek)
